cindrake.lore: Sleeps inside cooling lava crusts and wakes cranky.

flarefox.lore: Its tail sheds sparks when it laughs.

pyrowl.lore: Watches over campfires, and judges the cooking.

solwyrm.lore: Said to have swallowed a sunrise and never let go.

puddlewog.lore: Every puddle is a door, if you believe hard enough.

finnick.lore: Schools of them spell words no one can read.

leviarch.lore: Its song carries across three seas and one rift.

leafgrub.lore: Chews perfect circles through anything green.

thornhog.lore: Curls up at compliments. Uncurls at snacks.

mossbuck.lore: Flowers bloom where it has slept.

elderback.lore: An entire village once lived on its shell.

zapbee.lore: Hums in the key of approaching weather.

voltmouse.lore: Stores lightning in its cheeks for later.

galehawk.lore: Rides the edge of every storm front.

pebblenip.lore: Collects shiny gravel. Trades it poorly.

shalesnail.lore: Leaves a trail of polished stone.

cragrhino.lore: Walks through walls. Not around them.

bouldermoth.lore: Its footsteps are mistaken for earthquakes.

hushwing.lore: You never hear it. You only notice what's missing.

riftwisp.lore: A loose thread of somewhere else.

nullspinner.lore: Its webs catch moments, not flies.

nyxcat.lore: Walks between worlds whenever it's bored.

pyrocrest.lore: Its crest glows hotter the angrier it gets.

ashwolf.lore: Born from a fox that refused to fall.

bogmonarch.lore: Rules every puddle it has ever sat in.

thunderat.lore: Its cheeks finally ran out of room.

tidelance.lore: Cuts through drowned ruins like a spear.

bramblebear.lore: Stopped curling up. Started standing up.

lanternkit.lore: Carries a tiny flame in its tail. Where it comes from, the night never ends.

cogbeetle.lore: Ticks when it's happy. Winds itself up when it's sad.

starfinch.lore: Fell out of a sky with more stars than dark.

glassfox.lore: You can see through it. It can see through you.

mimicrate.lore: Looks like treasure. Isn't. Climbed up the stairs of a dungeon that never ends.

brinewyrm.lore: Swam here through a crack between two oceans.

duskwing.lore: The grub that grew up in the dark.

stormdrake.lore: A cindrake that learned lightning instead.

lanternlynx.lore: Its flame finally outgrew its tail.

cogtitan.lore: A beetle that kept winding itself until it became something else.

voth.lore: Her hair has never once lain flat, and never seems to grow. She eats enough for five, trains until she drops, and every time she's beaten half to death she gets back up stronger. She keeps one hand near the base of her spine when she thinks no one is looking, as if checking something is still gone.

ruri.lore: A hooded thief who never gives a straight answer. She has a soft spot for anything shiny, more kinds of arrows than seems reasonable, and a rope for every occasion. She prefers the word "entrepreneur".

tibrs.lore: A small girl in a red dress who carries a patched-up stuffed bear everywhere and talks to it like it talks back. It does. Things near her catch fire when she's upset, and she's upset quite often.

beast.lore: A towering, white-maned warrior who has fought on more worlds than he can count. He takes no joy in beating the weak. Somewhere, he says, is the one fighter strong enough to finally beat him, and he intends to meet them.

voth2.lore: Something tried to end her and could not. She fights as if she remembers exactly how close it came, because she does.

beast_awakened.lore: What Beast becomes when there is nobody left to protect but himself.

tibrsbear.lore: Tibrs's bear, awake and on fire.

peatbeaver.lore: Builds dams in places water hasn't reached yet.

fenwader.lore: Stands on one leg to hear the reeds better.

bogpuffer.lore: Inflates when frightened, and when bored.

mirehydra.lore: Grows another head every time it loses an argument.

glassshrimp.lore: Clear as a window. Crunchy as one too.

dunehopper.lore: Bounces between mirages to see which is real.

glasswyrm.lore: Swims through sand like it's water, and through glass like it's sand.

bellgull.lore: Nests in bell towers. Tone deaf.

rockotter.lore: Carries a favourite stone everywhere. Won't say why.

emberrooster.lore: Crows at sunset instead. Sets things on fire either way.

snowhare.lore: Leaves no tracks. Nobody knows how.

glacierbear.lore: Sleeps for a century, wakes up hungry.

stormyak.lore: Its fur crackles in dry weather. And wet weather.

hallsloth.lore: Has been crossing the Hall of Worlds for a very long time. Nearly there.

keychick.lore: Hatched from a key. Opens small doors.

echoling.lore: A little creature from a world made of squares. Beeps when happy.

doorhorn.lore: They say it opened the first door in the Hall. They say a lot of things.

candlewick.lore: A living candle. Very nervous around wind.

moonhound.lore: Howls at a moon that isn't there.

nightcrown.lore: The oldest owl in the Endless Night. It remembers the sun.

tinmouse.lore: Wind it up and it runs. Forget to, and it sulks.

clockheart.lore: The heart of Ironclock. If it stops, so does everything.

starjelly.lore: Glows the colour of whatever star it last touched.

voidwhale.lore: Sings between the islands of Starlane. The islands listen.

porcelainswan.lore: Elegant, cold, and very easily offended.

jestermonkey.lore: Steals hats. Nobody in the Court wears hats anymore.

maskqueen.lore: Has a thousand faces. None of them are hers.

lurker.lore: Waits under the stairs of the Undercroft. Very patient.

reefseal.lore: Claps for no reason. It's contagious.

crownfish.lore: Wears a crown of coral. Insists it's royalty.

damwarden.lore: A beaver who dammed a river that flowed between worlds.

tumbleknot.lore: A ball of dry roots with two seeds for eyes. It rolls instead of walks, and it rolls toward whoever is kindest.

sootling.lore: A smudge of soot the size of a cat, coal-red cracks glowing through. Its footprints fade before you can follow them.

ticktail.lore: A grey lizard whose tail swings like a pendulum. It flinches one second before anything happens.

pipwisp.lore: A candle flame with a calm little face. It dims when its Keeper is hurt, and it has never once gone out.

gullet.lore: A pelican-frog with a throat pouch that holds exactly one thing. It will not say what.

scrapbit.lore: A wind-up mouse of mismatched cogs. One eye is a bolt. Someone keeps winding it, and it isn't you.

lanternjack.lore: A scarecrow with a paper lantern for a head. The flame is pale by day. Nobody has watched it at night and said what colour it was.

bristlemaw.lore: A boar built like a bear trap, with an iron-bristle mane. It gets faster the more it bleeds, and it bleeds a lot.

hushmoth.lore: A moth with drum-skin wings that eats noise. Battles near it go quiet. So do arguments.

marrowlark.lore: A songbird skeleton with a clay heart. It sings the last thing it heard, which is not always a song.

coilcat.lore: A cat whose tail is a coiled steel spring. It lands on its feet from any height and is smug about it.

driftling.lore: A sleeping child-shaped cloud that drifts one place per hour. Where it drifts, people sleep well.

gravemantis.lore: A grey mantis whose forearms are one oversized rusted blade. It is slow, and it only needs to hit once.

bellwether.lore: A pale deer with a cracked bell for a heart. It rings once when a secret is near, then pretends it didn't.

hollowknave.lore: A child-sized suit of hollow armour, nothing inside but a faint blue light. It stands guard over things it doesn't remember.

emberwarden.lore: A kneeling figure of ash holding a single ember. It keeps the flame the way other things keep secrets.

slimeregent.lore: A slime wearing a tiny bent crown, seated on a throne of smaller slimes. It has never been told no.

shardheart.lore: A floating cluster of violet crystal with one ring of small eyes. It hums a chord that almost sounds like a word.

valdrekk.lore: A red dragon with a torn wing and old burns down one flank. It has lost exactly one fight, and it is still looking for whoever won it.

slime_guardian.lore: A slime that grew a body of iron and red muscle to protect something. Nobody has seen what. It doesn't blink, because it can't.

golgotha.lore: A skull half-drowned in tar-black slime, spined like a crown. Things that fall into it are not digested. They are kept.

sable.lore: A duellist with a blade that fires. Nobody has seen the second shot; nobody has needed to.

foxsonik.lore: A white fox that arrives before its own sound. It looks smug about it, and is.

wrenna.lore: A summoner in white who never summons the same thing twice, and never says what she is calling.

boltwarden.lore: A hollow suit of clockwork armour with a cannon for an arm. Something inside it hums when it is happy.

seren.lore: She left a palace with a borrowed name and a song she could no longer sing. Now she listens at empty doors until something on the other side remembers the tune.

cael.lore: He carries a blade too heavy for an ordinary life and hears names nobody else can hear. In the space between worlds, he is learning which voices belong to the dead—and which belong to him.

soren.lore: He used to count every heartbeat before pulling the trigger in his sword. Since crossing the Rift, there is always one extra beat. He has begun leaving room for it.

axiom.lore: Built to rescue people from machines, it learned too well how machines can hurt. Each borrowed weapon is stored beside a promise to find another use for it.

veyra.lore: A courier from a coast where roads curled above the sea. She still keeps one bright ring on a cord, although she will not say why dropping it frightens her.

bram.lore: A repairman who has followed too many broken pipes into impossible kingdoms. He taps every low ceiling before walking beneath it, then smiles as though expecting a gift.

rowan.lore: He has outlived the names on his sword and the hands that taught him to hold it. Thunder sometimes follows him indoors. He apologizes before drawing the blade.

mossbell.lore: A little moss-covered bell that rings for paths nobody has walked yet. Travelers who follow it often arrive somewhere they did not know they missed.

orrix.lore: It collects things that fall upward. The stone above its back is not a pet or a weapon; it is the last piece of a sky that trusted it.

vesper.lore: Folded from a letter that was never delivered, it searches faces for a name the rain erased. Its wings rustle most softly beside people who are waiting.

kilnfang.lore: Someone left a toy beside an unattended kiln. By morning the toy was gone, and something enormous was keeping the abandoned workshop warm.

nullprior.lore: A faceless keeper of doors that should never be opened. Its sermons remove sound, but the congregation always hears its own name.

brasswidow.lore: It still guards a clockmaker’s workshop that no longer exists. Every stolen gear goes into a careful pile beside the place where the workbench stood.

reedkip.lore: It weaves a little raft every evening, then sleeps beside it on the bank. Nobody has seen what it is waiting to ferry across.

cinderpip.lore: The first bird to sing after a forest fire. Its song is all the notes the flames could not burn.

hingeling.lore: When a door is forgotten, its hinge sometimes walks away. This one still turns toward every knock.

saltlick.lore: It licks the salt from old travelers’ boots. Sometimes it follows the taste of a road that vanished centuries ago.

inksnout.lore: It eats spilled ink and leaves the paper clean. The stories it swallows return in its dreams, and sometimes in its bite.

palinode.lore: Its hourglass contains the second before a promise was broken. Each time it turns, someone far away almost remembers another life.

velmora.lore: The fruit in its antlers is never ripe. Each pale moon holds a dream its maker was too afraid to finish.

astergrave.lore: An observatory fell into the sea between worlds. Something beneath it kept watching the stars until the building learned to walk.

nacresovereign.lore: A throne survived the drowning of its kingdom. The sea grew a monarch around it, and the empty streets still bow when it passes.

greatsword.d: Snapped halfway down. Some say it can be made whole again.

censer.d: Swings on a chain. Little lights follow it around.

staff.d: Warm at the tip, even at midnight.

gauntlets.d: They hum when you clench your fists.

scythe.d: The blade makes no sound. Neither does anything it cuts.

sai.d: Two points, perfectly balanced, slightly different lengths.

cindergunblade.d: Every swing ends in a bang. Nobody knows where it gets the powder.

rustgunblade.d: The trigger sticks. The blade doesn't.

tinchakram.d: A throwing ring from a travelling troupe.

anchorwhip.d: Pulled off a ship that sank somewhere it shouldn't have.

wardlantern.d: Its light makes wounds close a little faster.

miner.d: Smells of oil and old stories.

chapelbell.d: Rung once, everyone nearby stands a little straighter.

ashgrimoire.d: The pages burn as you read them, and grow back overnight.

ledger.d: Nothing written yet. Give it time.

fishspear.d: Good for fish. Surprisingly good for everything else.

parasol.d: Keeps off the rain, the sun and most swords.

galefans.d: Open them and the air takes a step back.

paperfans.d: Painted with a crane on each. One of the cranes blinks.

horizonbow.d: Arrows land where you were looking, not where you aimed.

faultmaul.d: The ground remembers every time it's been hit with this.

smithhammer.d: Still has a bit of a horseshoe stuck to it.

tidespear.d: The tip is a sliver of the Riftscar itself.

pocketdial.d: A clock you swing at people. It ticks faster when you're winning.

tavernlute.d: Missing a string. Plays better for it.

minstrellute.d: Every song it plays is about you. Awkward.

rowingoar.d: From a boat that sank. The oar didn't.

ferryoar.d: Once rowed souls across something wide and dark.

bonedice.d: Heavy for their size. Suspiciously heavy.

fatedice.d: Roll them and something happens. What, exactly, is between you and the dice.

practicerapier.d: The tip is blunt. Your intentions aren't.

hunterang.d: Comes back every time. Brings friends, sometimes.

stillblade.d: Drawn and sheathed in the same breath.

tidetrident.d: The sea answers when you point it.

stormkite.d: Flown in thunderstorms on purpose. By you, now.

paperkite.d: A child's kite with a sharpened string.

hallkey.d: Big enough to swing, old enough to open doors nobody else can.

vanitymirror.d: Shows you at your best. Enemies hate that.

compact.d: Seven years' bad luck, already spent.

bellflail.d: A church bell on a chain. Loud.

moonglaive.d: Its edge is always the shape of tonight's moon.

starbow.d: Strung with light from a dead star.

frostspear.d: Blue ice runs through the shaft. It never melts.

glasscensor.d: Burns salt instead of incense. Smells like the sea remembering.

deeplantern.d: Its light goes down stairs before you do.

vault_tidecaller.d: A trident from the drowned vault. The sea listens to it. Every thrust pulls the water with it.
vault_tidecaller.lore: A trident from the drowned vault. The sea listens to it. Every thrust pulls the water with it.

gs_glacier.d: The blade is a single shard of blue ice that never melts.

gs_ash.d: Too heavy for most. Leaves embers where it lands.

db_twin.d: A matched pair, sharpened by someone patient.

db_mirror.d: Each blade reflects the other's last cut.

db_venom.d: The grooves in the blades are always slightly wet.

sc_soul.d: The handle is warm, like a hand has only just let go of it.

sc_frost.d: Frost blooms along the blade with every swing.

st_wind.d: They come back if the wind likes you.

st_prism.d: Split the light into seven cuts.

ku_plain.d: Six blades, one wrap of cloth.

ku_shade.d: Where they land, shadows can't move.

ka_court.d: Hidden in a glove, drawn in a heartbeat.

cl_bone.d: Carved from something that had them first.

cl_blood.d: They drink a little of whatever they cut.

nu_oak.d: Two sticks, one chain, many bruises.

nu_bell.d: Tiny bells on the chain keep the rhythm.

bo_earth.d: Every sweep shakes the ground a little.

ha_guard.d: Once guarded a door nobody remembers.

ha_war.d: It remembers every door it guarded.

ax_quake.d: Splits stone as easily as wood.

tx_raider.d: Two small axes, very bad manners.

tx_crimson.d: Painted red. The paint was not paint.

cb_hunt.d: Slow to load, quick to settle arguments.

cb_gale.d: The wind itself carries the bolt.

sl_leather.d: A shepherd's weapon, older than swords.

sl_skip.d: Stones skip twice before they hit.

or_arcane.d: It hums a note only magic can hear.

hp_heal.d: Its song knits skin back together.

ks_chain.d: A sickle, a chain, a weight.

ks_shadow.d: It pulls enemies out of their own shadows.

cn_walk.d: There's a blade in it. Obviously.

cd_trick.d: You never draw the same hand twice.

hg_sand.d: The sand runs sideways when you're nervous.

la_jousting.d: Built for tournaments. Works on monsters.

la_dawn.d: Its tip catches the first light of every morning.

to_guard.d: Standard issue for the Ironclock watch.

an_ship.d: Somebody had to carry it off the wreck.

bn_war.d: Keepers stand taller when it flies.

or_dream.d: Look into it too long and you'll sleep.

ha_gravity.d: Swinging it feels like moving a mountain. So does being hit by it.

my_hourglass.d: The first Keeper carried this through the Hall of Worlds. Its sand is made of seconds that were never used, and when it runs out, so does whatever you're fighting. Nobody knows who turned it last.
my_hourglass.lore: The first Keeper carried this through the Hall of Worlds. Its sand is made of seconds that were never used, and when it runs out, so does whatever you're fighting. Nobody knows who turned it last.

my_nothing.d: A scythe with no blade, only the shape of one. It cuts the part of things that holds them together, and what's left simply forgets to exist. It's said to belong to the god of nothing, and to be looking for its way home.
my_nothing.lore: A scythe with no blade, only the shape of one. It cuts the part of things that holds them together, and what's left simply forgets to exist. It's said to belong to the god of nothing, and to be looking for its way home.

my_stars.d: A handful of throwing stars that were once real stars. Throw them and the night sky above you goes dark for a moment, while they remember what they used to be.
my_stars.lore: A handful of throwing stars that were once real stars. Throw them and the night sky above you goes dark for a moment, while they remember what they used to be.

my_dawn.d: Forged on the morning the Endless Night was meant to end. That morning never came, so the sword carries the sunrise with it instead, and it has been waiting a very long time to use it.
my_dawn.lore: Forged on the morning the Endless Night was meant to end. That morning never came, so the sword carries the sunrise with it instead, and it has been waiting a very long time to use it.

my_bloodmoon.d: Worn by a hunter from a world with a red moon. They grow sharper the more they drink, and they are always thirsty. The hunter's name was scratched out of every record.
my_bloodmoon.lore: Worn by a hunter from a world with a red moon. They grow sharper the more they drink, and they are always thirsty. The hunter's name was scratched out of every record.

my_world.d: The blade that cut the Riftscar open. It is heavier than it should be, because it still carries the weight of a world it split in two. Some say the other half is looking for it.
my_world.lore: The blade that cut the Riftscar open. It is heavier than it should be, because it still carries the weight of a world it split in two. Some say the other half is looking for it.

my_verse.d: The Painted Court's final musician played this at the end of their world. The song was so sad the world stopped to listen and never started again. Only the last verse is left.
my_verse.lore: The Painted Court's final musician played this at the end of their world. The song was so sad the world stopped to listen and never started again. Only the last verse is left.

my_dream.d: An orb that is also an eye, and the eye is asleep. Whatever it dreams about stops existing in the waking world. Try not to wake it.
my_dream.lore: An orb that is also an eye, and the eye is asleep. Whatever it dreams about stops existing in the waking world. Try not to wake it.

my_tide.d: It holds Tidewrought's stacked seas apart. Carried off, it turns the tide of any fight, and somewhere two oceans lean a little closer together.
my_tide.lore: It holds Tidewrought's stacked seas apart. Carried off, it turns the tide of any fight, and somewhere two oceans lean a little closer together.

my_storm.d: A banner woven from a storm that was taught to stand still. Raise it and the storm remembers it was never meant to be tame.
my_storm.lore: A banner woven from a storm that was taught to stand still. Raise it and the storm remembers it was never meant to be tame.

my_shadow.d: Two blades, and a hundred more that only exist while you're moving. The Undercroft's thieves swear the shadows still steal on their own.
my_shadow.lore: Two blades, and a hundred more that only exist while you're moving. The Undercroft's thieves swear the shadows still steal on their own.

my_fate.d: Every card is a possible future, and the deck deals the one you'd least expect. The Mask Queen lost it in a bet she still claims she won.
my_fate.lore: Every card is a possible future, and the deck deals the one you'd least expect. The Mask Queen lost it in a bet she still claims she won.

my_winter.d: A lance of ice from the heart of the Frostvein Peaks. Where it strikes, winter comes and refuses to leave.
my_winter.lore: A lance of ice from the heart of the Frostvein Peaks. Where it strikes, winter comes and refuses to leave.

my_phoenix.d: Two pistols that fire embers of a phoenix that died and chose not to come back. Every shot is a small resurrection.
my_phoenix.lore: Two pistols that fire embers of a phoenix that died and chose not to come back. Every shot is a small resurrection.

shard_meadow.d: A jagged sliver of metal. It smells like cut grass.

shard_ember.d: Warm to the touch, even in the rain.

shard_tide.d: Beads of water form on it out of nowhere.

sigil.d: Three pieces, one shape. It feels like it belongs to someone important.

crackedwatch.d: The hands twitch, but never move.

glowsand.d: It falls upward if you aren't watching.

stoppedwatch.d: It has stopped at a minute that doesn't exist.

lens.d: Everything through it looks slightly further away.

seerlens.d: Words swim in the glass when you hold it near the Gate.

feather.d: Drop it and it just… stays.

hgfeather.d: It keeps time with something far away.

dice.d: They always land on a number you weren't expecting.

bentkey.d: It fits nothing you've tried. Yet.

crown.d: There's nothing in the middle. That's the point.

draught.d: Bitter, strong, and it hums faintly. You feel wide awake just holding it.

pshard.d: A sliver of a working portal. The broken ones seem to want it.

speakstone.d: A smooth stone that hums when held to your lips. Your words go further than they should, once.

hallhorn.d: A pale blue stone cut from the Hall of Worlds. Speak into it and every world hears you, once.

greycoin.d: Cold, no matter how long you hold it.

note_self.text: If you're reading this, you opened the door. Good. Don't trust the Mask Queen's first face. Don't trust her second either. The Bell is not the only thing sleeping in the Shallows. — You

page_journal.text: Day forty. The broken portals aren't broken. They're waiting. I think they want something that used to fit in them. I found a sliver of one today and it hummed in my hand like it knew me.

keeper_letter.text: To whoever finds my coin: keep it cold, keep it close. When she asks you her question, don't answer as a hero. Answer as yourself. That's the only answer she accepts.

fen_hymn.text: Sing low, sing slow, the reeds will know / what drowned below, what drowned below. (Someone has pencilled in the margin: 'Whispering. Reed. Hymn. Don't.')

clock_timetable.d: Every train arrives on time. There are no trains.
clock_timetable.text: The heart is wound at dawn. If the heart is not wound, the dawn is not wound either. Do not let the heart be stolen. (Page 7 is missing.)

star_chart.d: Some of the stars are circled.
star_chart.text: Circled: three stars in a row, labelled Star, Orbit, Falling. Beneath them, very small: 'the whale sings where these meet.'

court_invite.text: You are cordially invited to the Masquerade. Masks required. Faces optional. Those who arrive as themselves will be asked to leave, or to stay forever.

deep_map.d: A map of stairs. Only stairs.
deep_map.text: Stair nine hundred: a bone door. Behind it: 'Locked. Locked. Locked.' The word is written three times, and then crossed out once.

lady_riddle.d: Scratched into a tile from a very old floor.
lady_riddle.text: I ask one thing of every one. The answer isn't brave, or clever, or kind. It's true. That's all. That's the hard part.

tome_mirror.d: The pages show your reflection moving a moment early.
tome_mirror.text: Step where your reflection already is. Don't think about it too hard. It hates that.

tome_veil.d: Warm to the touch, like something alive.
tome_veil.text: The veil is hungry. Feed it your enemy, and it feeds you. Never feed it a friend.

tome_dawn.d: A prayer written by someone who'd never seen a sunrise.
tome_dawn.text: Imagine the first light. Now imagine it sharp.

tome_bell.d: A treatise. Mostly blank. On purpose.
tome_bell.text: Ring nothing. Loudly. (The rest of the book is empty pages. The emptiness feels like it's listening.)

tome_rewind.d: Its pages turn backwards on their own.
tome_rewind.text: .tsap eht ot nruter ot woh si sihT (It reads more easily the second time. Then you realise you've read it before.)

tome_knots.d: Diagrams of knots that can't exist.
tome_knots.text: Tie the knot in the moment, not in the rope.

tome_dread.text: Show them what's under their bed. You don't have to know what it is. They do.

tome_elixir.d: Grease-stained. Half the ingredients are feelings.
tome_elixir.text: One part water, one part hope, a pinch of salt from the Flats. Shake. Breathe it out.

tome_hearth.d: A song your grandmother might have known.
tome_hearth.text: Sing it quietly and the cold stays outside.

fishingpole.d: A bent rod and a length of line. Use it where there's water.

herbsatchel.d: Lined with dozens of little pockets. Things worth picking seem to find their way in.

pickaxe.d: Chipped, but the point is still sharp.

brewpot.d: A small iron pot, still stained with someone else's experiments.

cookpan.d: Well-seasoned. Smells faintly of a hundred old meals.

anvilhammer.d: Heavy and balanced. Useless without an anvil.

emberroot.d: Warm to the touch, even in winter.

saltbloom.d: A flower made of salt crystals.

glassfin.d: You can see right through it.

tidecarp.d: Swims up as easily as down.

goldkoi.d: Rare and very pleased with itself.

voidfish.d: Where its eyes should be, there's nothing at all.

copperore.d: Turns green if you leave it too long.

frostcrystal.d: Never melts. Never quite stops being cold.

riftshard.d: A piece of broken space. Hums.

goldnugget.d: Rare, shiny, heavier than it looks.

p_heal.d: A red draught. Nobody is sure what it does yet.

p_ess.d: It hums faintly. Its purpose is still a mystery.

p_luck.d: Smells like clover. What it does is anyone's guess.

p_swift.d: Fizzes when shaken. Its use hasn't been discovered.

p_calm.d: Soothing to smell. It doesn't seem to do anything yet.

p_grow.d: Something green floats in it. Its purpose is unknown.

p_gold.d: Glitters like gold. Nobody knows what it's for yet.

p_moon.d: For 15 minutes, it counts as night. Some souls care about that.

sludge.d: Whatever this was meant to be, it isn't.

m_tea.d: Restores 20 stamina. Warm all the way down.

note_lamp.d: A diary page, the ink still warm.
note_lamp.text: Night 4,012. The dark came closer again tonight. I lit every lamp twice. The Endless Night hates being looked at. Keep it looked at.

note_wanted.d: A hooded face, drawn badly on purpose.
note_wanted.text: WANTED: a hooded thief, known to swing from rafters and steal anything shiny. Last seen with a wizard and a knight. Reward: whatever she hasn't taken yet.

note_drawing.d: A child's crayon drawing, burnt at the edges.
note_drawing.text: A little girl, a big bear, and a house on fire. Everyone in the drawing is smiling except the people running away.

note_tally.d: Scratches carved into a slab of bone.
note_tally.text: Hundreds of marks, one for each fight. Each row ends with a single word, scratched harder than the rest: unworthy.

note_clock.text: One (1) second, repaired. One (1) minute, polished. One (1) hour, refused: too heavy to lift. Customer paid in unused time.

note_map.d: The corner of a much bigger map.
note_map.text: Someone drew doors all over this map, in places where there are no doors. Next to one, in tiny letters: 'the Hall has more rooms than it admits.'

q_mapleft.text: The drowned bell tower is marked with an X. The rest of the route is on the missing half, and the edge is crusted with salt.

q_mapright.d: The other half of the sea chart.
q_mapright.text: Together the halves show a vault under the Sunken Shallows' bell tower. A note in the corner: 'Only open it at low tide. There is no low tide.'

q_fork.d: Hums whenever a bell rings nearby.
q_fork.text: Engraved on the handle: 'The last song of the Painted Court was never finished. Finish it where the bells can hear.'

q_sheet.d: Music with the last line left blank.
q_sheet.text: The final line is empty, but the fork hums a note when you hold it over the gap. It sounds like it wants the cliffs, and the dark.

q_grain.d: A single grain of glowing sand.
q_grain.text: It's warm and it ticks. Seconds nobody ever spent. It seems to want to be with others like it.

vault_tidecaller.text: We hid the Tidecaller here when the town sank. Whoever finds it: the sea listens to it. Be kind to the sea.

q_page1.text: Day one. The Hall has more doors than it shows. I mean to open all of them.

q_page2.text: The sea here is stacked like floors of a house. I swam up three of them before I ran out of breath.

q_page3.text: The stars run like rivers here. I followed one to its end. There was a whale made of nothing, singing.

q_page4.text: They asked me to dance. I said I was only passing through. They said everyone says that.

q_page5.text: Nine hundred stairs down, and a door made of bone that remembers everyone who ever touched it.

q_page6.text: The lamplighter says the dark came from a world that ended. I think the dark is just lonely.

q_page7.text: I'm getting tired. I've been given more time than anyone should have. Maybe I'll make an hourglass of it.

meadow.d: Gentle fields where most tamers catch their first friends.

emberwood.d: A forest that never quite stops smouldering.

shallows.d: Drowned ruins, restless tides and something watching.

riftscar.d: Where the world tore open. Rare souls drift through.

fen.d: Reeds that whisper back over still, black water. Don't answer them.

flats.d: A dried sea turned to glass. Mirages walk here.

cliffs.d: Old bell towers cling to the cliff edge above a restless sea. The wind rings them.

peaks.d: Mountains with blue veins of ice. Something sleeps in every cave.

hall.d: A hall with no end and a door for every world. Most are shut. Some are ajar.

night.d: A world where the sun never rose. Everything makes its own light.

clock.d: A city of gears. Even the weather is wound up each morning.

star.d: Islands drifting between stars. Don't look down. There is no down.

court.d: Mirrors, masks and manners. Everyone is lying, beautifully.

deep.d: Stairs that go down forever, and doors that were locked for a reason.

tidew.d: Oceans stacked on oceans. The sky is also water.

a.t: A small girl in a red dress sits on the edge of the fountain, whispering to a patched-up stuffed bear. The bear's one button eye glows like an ember. She looks up at you. "Bear says you're nice. Can we come with you?"

c.end: She beams and grabs your sleeve. "Bear, we have a friend!" Somewhere nearby, a hedge quietly catches fire.
She shrugs and goes back to whispering. You're sure the bear is watching you leave.

b.t: She hugs the bear tighter. "They were scared of me. Everyone was. So I made them go away." The fountain water starts to steam. "Bear isn't scared. Are you scared?"

c.end: The steam settles. She takes your hand. "Bear says you're brave. Bear is never wrong."
You leave. Behind you, someone's hat is on fire.

a.t: A notice board leans beside the cracked portal, layered with scraps from Keepers you'll never meet.

say.voth: Half of these are lies. The other half are worse.
say.ruri: Look at that one. Somebody drew a cave.
say.beast: It sniffs the board. One note smells of salt.

c.end: You read it twice. It still doesn't quite make sense.
Maybe later.

b.t: The oldest notice is almost blank. Only three words are legible, pressed hard into the paper.

c.end: You press charcoal over it. One of the words comes through clearly.

a.t: Standing stones hum in a ring. One stone is missing, leaving a gap shaped like a doorway.

say.voth: I've seen this ring before. In another world. It was smaller.
say.ruri: Doorways without doors are my favourite kind.
say.beast: Beast won't go near the gap.

c.l: (At night) Wait for the stones to speak

c.end: The humming follows you for a while.

b.t: For a heartbeat you stand somewhere else: a field of glass under two moons. Then you're back, holding something warm.

c.end: A tablet from somewhere else. One word: Endless.

c.t: The carvings are a map of the Hall's doors. One door is drawn open, with a lantern hanging in it.

c.end: Something settles behind your eyes. The dark looks thinner now. You've learned Lantern-Sight.
You copy it onto a scrap, and find an old lens wedged beneath the stone.

a.t: An old kiln still burns with no fuel. Something inside is knocking to be let out.

say.voth: Whatever's in there wants out more than we want in.

c.end: The door bursts open!

c.l: (Zoy in your team) Let Zoy look first

c.end: The knocking gets quieter, then stops.

b.t: Zoy steps into the flame and back out in the same instant, two knives' worth of ash on her boots and something red in her hand.

c.end: She shrugs. "Someone who owed me money." She hands you a red shard.

c.t: The kiln roars white. The knocking stops. A small red shard rolls out onto the ash.

c.end: It's still warm.

a.t: Under the water, voices sing. A bell hangs from a drowned arch, just within reach.

say.voth: Don't. Some things sleep for a reason.
say.ruri: Ring it. Ring it. Ring it.

c.end: The singing stops. Everything goes very still. Somewhere far below, something opens its eyes.

c.l: (Beast in your team) Let Beast listen

c.end: The song follows you out of the water.

b.t: Beast hums along with the choir. A small soul drifts out of the water and curls up beside it.

c.end: It follows you now.

woke.t: The bell hangs silent. The water is too still. Someone rang it before you, and now something enormous circles far below.

c.end: It rises to meet you!
Probably wise.

a.t: A mirror floats in the air. Your reflection is there, but hiding, blending into nothing.

say.voth: That isn't you. It's who you'd be if you stopped trying.

c.end: For a moment you are nowhere. It's comfortable. Too comfortable. You step back out.
It mouths one word back at you. Hollow.
It watches you go.

b.t: Hidden, you watch the reflection. After a long moment it turns and waves at you. Nobody else could have seen that.

c.end: It presses something through the glass. A bent key.

a.t: A door stands open a crack. Behind it you hear rain, laughter, and someone saying your name.

say.voth: I came through a door like that once. I don't recommend it.

c.end: The voice stops, as if it noticed you listening. You hear one word before the door clicks shut: Threshold.
The latch clicks. The rain stops.

b.t: A room from another world: a tavern, empty, a meal still steaming, and a note on the table with your name on it. A pale blue stone sits on the mantel, humming.

c.end: It hums against your palm. Somewhere, every world is waiting to hear you.
It's in your handwriting. You don't remember writing it.
It's the best thing you've ever tasted. You feel wide awake.

a.t: The reeds are singing the hymn from the old sheet music. They stop the moment you get close.

say.voth: Don't sing along. Whatever taught them that song is still listening.
say.ruri: I know this one! …No I don't.

c.end: The reeds sing the next verse for you. You understand one word of it: Hymn.

c.l: (Beast in your team) Let Beast howl
c.end: Something small and round floats up out of the bog, delighted, and follows Beast home.
The singing starts again behind you.

b.t: The reeds part. Half-sunk in the mud is a chapel door, and something heavy is breathing behind it.

c.end: The door bursts off its hinges!
You tuck the old hymn sheet into your bag. You'll come back.

a.t: A mirage of a city shimmers across the salt. In one window, someone who looks exactly like you is waving.

say.ruri: Let me throw something at it.

c.end: Through the glass, the city is a word written in the air: Mirage.

c.l: (Zoy in your team) Let Zoy loose an arrow
c.end: The mirage pops like a bubble. Zoy's arrow comes back with a coin purse stuck to it.
Your double stops waving. That's worse, somehow.

b.t: You walk into the city. It's cool and quiet. When you walk out the other side, you're holding a glass shard with a word scratched into it.

c.end: Glass. And beside it, an old lens.

a.t: Every bell tower on the cliffs rings at once, then stops. One bell keeps swinging, silently.

say.voth: I know that tune. It's older than the towers.

c.end: The wind spells out a single word as it passes: Wind.

c.l: (Voth in your team) Ask Voth about the tune
c.end: Voth hums it once. A smooth stone falls from the silent bell into your hand.
The bells ring again when you're gone.

b.t: At the top: a bell with no clapper. A Bellgull has made its nest inside.

c.end: It drops a shiny coin at your feet as thanks.
The gull does not appreciate that.

a.t: An ice cave glows blue in the mountainside. Footprints lead in. None lead out.

say.voth: Those prints are old. Very old.
say.ruri: Treasure. There's always treasure in these.

c.end: The ice obeys you. One word forms in the frost: Frozen.
Probably wise.

b.t: Deep inside, a Glacier Bear sleeps curled around a pile of lost things.

c.end: You slip out with coins and a shard of a working portal. The bear never stirs.
It wakes up hungry!
You tiptoe out.

a.t: A lamplighter holds out a candle. "It'll light the way to what you've lost."

say.beast: Beast sniffs the flame and sneezes.

c.end: She smiles for the first time in a century. "Candle," she says, and fades.

c.l: (Beast in your team) Let Beast sniff it
c.end: The candle hops off the holder and follows Beast. It's alive.

b.t: The flame leans toward the Moon Well. At the bottom, something small and grey glints.

c.end: A small grey coin. Cold, no matter how long you hold it.

a.t: Ironclock's great clock skips a beat. Everyone in the square freezes, mid-step. Everyone except you.

say.ruri: I can move! Why can I move?

c.end: You push the moment along with your own hands. The city starts breathing again.
Time lurches forward. Nobody noticed but you.

b.t: Inside the tower, a thief with gears for hands is prying a piece out of the Clockheart.

c.end: The thief whistles, and a Steam Boar charges out of the gears!
They vanish with the piece. Somewhere in Ironclock, the heart beats a little slower now.

woke.t: The great clock ticks slowly, a piece of its heart missing. Someone let the thief go.

c.end: The Clockheart itself lurches out to find its missing piece!
Tick. Tock. Tick.

a.t: A song drifts between the floating islands. Somewhere out there, a whale is singing.

say.voth: Don't let it hear you afraid.
say.ruri: It's beautiful. I hate that it's beautiful.

c.end: The song changes to answer yours. One word hangs in the stars afterwards: Orbit.
The song follows you for a while.

b.t: The Voidwhale surfaces through the stars, as big as an island, and turns one ancient eye toward you.

c.end: It blinks, slowly. You feel rested, and a little bigger inside.

c.l: Try to steal its soul (it's far too strong)
c.end: It does not like that.

a.t: A masked servant bows. "Your mask, honoured guest?" You don't have one.

say.voth: Everyone here is lying. Including the walls.
say.ruri: I'll get us masks. Don't ask how.
say.beast: Beast is already wearing a lampshade.

c.end: The servant sees a mask that isn't there, and bows lower. "Mask," he whispers, like a password.

c.l: (Zoy in your team) Let Zoy handle it

b.t: Inside, the Mask Queen dances with a guest who is wearing your face.

c.end: She laughs with a thousand mouths!
You leave with an invitation to next year's Masquerade, and a rumour.

a.t: Stair nine hundred. A door made of bone, and the lock is on your side.

say.voth: Locked from this side means it's keeping something in.
say.ruri: Or keeping us out. Let's find out.

c.end: Something knocks back, from right behind you!
Someone on the other side is whispering one word over and over: Locked.

b.t: The bent key turns. Behind the bone door is another stair. It goes up.

c.end: At the top: daylight, coins scattered on the steps, and a word carved into the last stair. Bone.

a.t: Here the sky is water. A pearl drifts down past you, falling upward.

say.voth: In Tidewrought, down is a suggestion.
say.beast: Beast tries to swim in the air.

c.end: You swim through the sky-sea. Written on the surface, from underneath: Twice.
It falls up and away.

b.t: The pearl opens in your hand. Inside is a tiny, perfect Crownfish, blinking at you.

c.end: It swims in a little circle around your head. It's yours now.
It swims off into the sky. You feel lighter.
